context: Reach <5% false positive and <50% false negative on contact detection with a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder plus a small trained head, on a high-quality mixed synthetic+real dataset.
prompt:
Attached are 5 contact sheets, each 48 frames sampled evenly (6 columns x 8 rows, chronological) from a single Tesla Sentry Mode field clip recorded by the owner's own car. For EACH image, decide whether anything physically touched the car anywhere in the clip. Output exactly one line per event:
<event>: VERDICT=contact|near_miss|quiet|unclear; ACTOR=<who/what or none>; CONFIDENCE=low|medium|high; NOTE=<up to 12 words>
Definitions: contact = something physically touches the car; near_miss = a person or object approaches closely but no contact is visible; quiet = nobody/nothing approaches; unclear = cannot tell.
Images:
Image 1: 2026-09-09_15-46-42
Image 2: 2026-09-09_15-50-14
Image 3: 2026-09-09_19-09-53
Image 4: 2026-09-09_19-12-57
Image 5: 2026-09-10_11-17-58
response:
2026-09-09_15-46-42: VERDICT=quiet; ACTOR=none; CONFIDENCE=medium; NOTE=Neighboring open door remains stationary; no visible approach or contact.
2026-09-09_15-50-14: VERDICT=quiet; ACTOR=none; CONFIDENCE=medium; NOTE=Adjacent car stays stationary; distant pedestrians do not approach recording car.
2026-09-09_19-09-53: VERDICT=unclear; ACTOR=person beside car; CONFIDENCE=low; NOTE=Person appears at right edge; possible interaction obscured by car.
2026-09-09_19-12-57: VERDICT=near_miss; ACTOR=person walking beside car; CONFIDENCE=medium; NOTE=Person approaches twice and passes close; no contact visible.
2026-09-10_11-17-58: VERDICT=quiet; ACTOR=none; CONFIDENCE=high; NOTE=Stationary neighboring car; no visible approach or contact.
